title: बालकाण्ड
scope: Complete chapter-arc comic retelling; not a verse-by-verse edition. Dialogues are original source-based paraphrases, not verbatim quotations.

episodes.title: कथा का जन्म
episodes.framing: प्रस्तावना: वाल्मीकि की कथा; दरबार का दृश्य बाद के समय का है।

panels.narration: वाल्मीकि ने नारद से पूछा कि गुण, साहस और सत्य के आदर्श को कौन जीता है। नारद ने राम की कथा सुनाई।
panels.speaker: वाल्मीकि
panels.dialogue: ऐसे गुणों वाला मनुष्य कौन है?
panels.artAction: Valmiki and Narada converse beneath trees at a quiet hermitage; Narada carries a veena, Valmiki listens thoughtfully.
panels.narrationEn: Valmiki asked Narada who lives the ideal of virtue, courage, and truth. Narada told him the story of Rama.
panels.dialogueEn: Who is the man with such virtues?

panels.narration: नारद ने राम के जन्म, वनवास, सीता की खोज, रावण से युद्ध और अयोध्या वापसी का संक्षिप्त परिचय दिया।
panels.speaker: नारद
panels.dialogue: मैं तुम्हें राम की कथा सुनाता हूँ।
panels.artAction: Narada speaks to Valmiki, gently gesturing through the story; depict only the two sages, no literal future-event montage.
panels.narrationEn: Narada gave a brief account of Rama's birth, his exile, the search for Sita, the war with Ravana, and the return to Ayodhya.
panels.dialogueEn: Let me tell you the story of Rama.

panels.narration: तमसा के तट पर एक शिकारी ने क्रौंच-पक्षी को मार दिया। दूसरे पक्षी का विलाप सुनकर वाल्मीकि का शोक छन्द बन गया।
panels.artAction: Valmiki and disciple Bharadvaja witness a grieving crane beside its fallen mate on riverbank; distant hunter, no blood or impact.
panels.narrationEn: On the bank of the Tamasa, a hunter killed a krauncha bird. Hearing the mate's lament, Valmiki's grief turned into verse.

panels.narration: ब्रह्मा ने वाल्मीकि को रामकथा रचने की प्रेरणा दी। ध्यान में उन्हें कथा के प्रसंग स्पष्ट हुए और उन्होंने काव्य की रूपरेखा बनाई।
panels.speaker: ब्रह्मा
panels.dialogue: राम का चरित्र काव्य में कहो।
panels.artAction: Four-headed four-armed Brahma blesses seated Valmiki at hermitage, serene divine light, palm-leaf writing materials nearby.
panels.narrationEn: Brahma inspired Valmiki to compose the story of Rama. In meditation, the episodes of the tale became clear to him, and he outlined the poem.
panels.dialogueEn: Tell the character of Rama in verse.

panels.narration: वाल्मीकि ने लव-कुश को काव्य सिखाया। बाद के समय में दोनों बालकों ने अयोध्या में राजा राम की सभा को रामकथा सुनाई।
panels.artAction: Explicit later-time framing: two child twins Lava and Kusha sing before adult crowned Rama; Valmiki's teaching recalled by manuscript, no infant princes.
panels.narrationEn: Valmiki taught the poem to Lava and Kusha. Later, the two boys recited the story of Rama to King Rama's court in Ayodhya.

episodes.framingEn: Prologue: Valmiki's story; the court scene belongs to a later time.

episodes.title: अयोध्या और उसका राजा
episodes.framing: अब कथा दशरथ के राज्य से आरम्भ होती है।

panels.narration: सरयू के किनारे अयोध्या बसी थी। राजा दशरथ के शासन में उसके मार्ग, बाजार और घर समृद्ध थे।
panels.artAction: Wide establishing view of Ayodhya beside Sarayu, busy shaded bazaar, families and craftsmen, warm golden palace in distance.
panels.narrationEn: Ayodhya stood on the bank of the Sarayu. Under King Dasharatha's rule, its streets, markets, and homes flourished.

panels.narration: दशरथ अपने मन्त्रियों और गुरु वसिष्ठ से परामर्श लेते थे। राज्य की व्यवस्था में विचार, अनुशासन और प्रजा का हित महत्त्व रखते थे।
panels.artAction: Older King Dasharatha holds council with gentle white-bearded Vashishtha and Sumantra, distinct dignified faces, no young Rama yet.
panels.narrationEn: Dasharatha consulted his ministers and his guru Vashishtha. In the governance of the kingdom, deliberation, discipline, and the welfare of the people mattered most.

episodes.framingEn: Now the story begins with Dasharatha's kingdom.

episodes.title: पुत्र की कामना
episodes.framing: सुमन्त्र पहले अंगदेश की घटना सुनाते हैं।

panels.narration: दशरथ को वंश के भविष्य की चिन्ता थी। उन्होंने यज्ञ का निश्चय किया। सुमन्त्र ने ऋष्यशृंग को बुलाने की सलाह दी।
panels.speaker: सुमन्त्र
panels.dialogue: ऋष्यशृंग को आमन्त्रित कीजिए।
panels.artAction: Dasharatha speaks privately with minister Sumantra, then turns toward Vashishtha for counsel in palace chamber.
panels.narrationEn: Dasharatha was troubled by the future of his lineage. He resolved to perform a yajna. Sumantra advised him to summon Rishyasringa.
panels.dialogueEn: Invite Rishyasringa.

panels.narration: अंगदेश में वर्षा न होने से संकट आया था। राजा रोमपाद ने वन में पले ऋष्यशृंग को बुलाने की योजना बनाई।
panels.artAction: Narrated flashback: dry Anga fields and worried Romapada; royal council considers how to invite young forest-dwelling ascetic Rishyasringa, no seductive posing.
panels.narrationEn: A crisis had struck Anga for lack of rain. King Romapada planned to summon Rishyasringa, who had grown up in the forest.

panels.narration: राजा के दूतों के रूप में नगर की स्त्रियाँ वन गईं। उन्होंने ऋष्यशृंग से मित्रता की और उन्हें फल-मिठाइयाँ दीं।
panels.artAction: Courteous fully clothed women from Anga visit young ascetic Rishyasringa in forest and offer fruit and sweets, respectful interaction, no seduction or physical intimacy.
panels.narrationEn: As the king's emissaries, women of the city went into the forest. They made friends with Rishyasringa and gave him fruits and sweets.

panels.narration: उनके लौटने पर ऋष्यशृंग उन्हें फिर खोजने निकले। स्त्रियाँ दोबारा मिलीं और उन्हें अपने साथ अंगदेश ले आईं।
panels.artAction: Rishyasringa follows the same fully clothed women toward Anga city gates, curious gentle expression, forest behind and city ahead.
panels.narrationEn: After they left, Rishyasringa set out to find them again. The women met him once more and brought him with them to Anga.

panels.narration: ऋष्यशृंग के अंगदेश आने पर वर्षा हुई। रोमपाद ने उनका सम्मान किया और शान्ता का विवाह उनसे हुआ।
panels.artAction: Rain refreshes Anga as Rishyasringa arrives; Shanta and Romapada welcome him under palace portico, respectful non-graphic marriage context.
panels.narrationEn: When Rishyasringa arrived in Anga, rain fell. Romapada honored him, and Shanta was married to him.

panels.narration: दशरथ स्वयं अंगदेश गए। रोमपाद की सहमति से ऋष्यशृंग और शान्ता उनके साथ अयोध्या आए, जहाँ उनका आदरपूर्वक स्वागत हुआ।
panels.artAction: Dasharatha welcomes Rishyasringa and Shanta at Ayodhya gateway, Romapada's farewell understood, no newborns yet.
panels.narrationEn: Dasharatha himself went to Anga. With Romapada's consent, Rishyasringa and Shanta came with him to Ayodhya, where they were received with honor.

episodes.framingEn: Sumantra first recounts the episode from Anga.

episodes.title: यज्ञ और देवसंकल्प
episodes.framing: राजधानी और देवलोक के प्रसंग साथ आगे बढ़ते हैं।

panels.narration: ऋष्यशृंग और वसिष्ठ के निर्देशन में अश्वमेध की तैयारी हुई। सरयू के उत्तरी तट पर अनुष्ठान पूरा हुआ; अतिथियों और सेवकों की व्यवस्था भी की गई।
panels.artAction: Rishyasringa and Vashishtha oversee orderly ritual by Sarayu, Dasharatha and three queens respectfully seated, guests fed nearby; no animal harm depicted.
panels.narrationEn: Under the direction of Rishyasringa and Vashishtha, preparations were made for the Ashvamedha. The rite was completed on the northern bank of the Sarayu; arrangements were also made for guests and attendants.

panels.narration: ऋष्यशृंग ने पुत्रेष्टि आरम्भ की। उधर देवताओं ने रावण के अत्याचार की शिकायत की; उसके वरदान में मनुष्यों से सुरक्षा नहीं माँगी गई थी।
panels.artAction: Celestial assembly petitions four-headed Brahma about Ravana's tyranny; show no Ravana portrait or multi-arm anatomy here, gods worried yet composed.
panels.narrationEn: Rishyasringa began the Putreshti rite. Meanwhile, the gods complained of Ravana's tyranny; in his boon, he had not asked for protection from humans.

panels.narration: विष्णु ने मनुष्यरूप में दशरथ के घर जन्म लेकर रावण के आतंक का अन्त करने का संकल्प किया।
panels.artAction: Four-armed blue Vishnu with conch discus mace lotus addresses Brahma and gods in a luminous celestial setting, exactly four connected arms.
panels.narrationEn: Vishnu resolved to take human form, be born in Dasharatha's house, and end Ravana's terror.

panels.narration: यज्ञाग्नि से प्रकट दिव्य पुरुष ने दशरथ को पायस दिया। राजा ने उसे तीनों रानियों में बाँटा; सुमित्रा को दो बार भाग मिला।
panels.artAction: Divine ritual messenger presents gold payasa vessel to Dasharatha, three distinct queens nearby; flame symbolic, no infant inside fire.
panels.narrationEn: A divine being appeared from the sacrificial fire and gave Dasharatha a vessel of payasa. The king divided it among his three queens; Sumitra received a share twice.

panels.narration: ब्रह्मा की प्रेरणा से देवताओं ने वानर-वीरों को जन्म दिया। आगे चलकर ये राम के कार्य में सहायक होने वाले थे।
panels.artAction: Foreshadowing of young vanara allies in lush forest under celestial blessing; ivory juvenile Hanuman without adult crown or gada, golden-brown and russet peers.
panels.narrationEn: At Brahma's prompting, the gods begot the vanara heroes. In time, these would come to aid Rama's cause.

episodes.titleEn: The Yajna and the Gods' Resolve
episodes.framingEn: The episodes in the capital and in the realm of the gods now proceed together.

episodes.title: चार राजकुमार
episodes.framing: शैशव से किशोरावस्था तक समय बीतता है।

panels.narration: कौसल्या से राम, कैकेयी से भरत और सुमित्रा से लक्ष्मण तथा शत्रुघ्न जन्मे। महल में चारों बालकों के जन्म का उत्सव मनाया गया।
panels.artAction: Three queens with exactly four infants: Kaushalya holds blue Rama, Kaikeyi holds Bharata, Sumitra holds two twins Lakshmana and Shatrughna; Dasharatha delighted.
panels.narrationEn: Rama was born to Kaushalya, Bharata to Kaikeyi, and Lakshmana and Shatrughna to Sumitra. The palace celebrated the birth of all four boys.

panels.narration: चारों भाई शिक्षा और शस्त्रविद्या सीखते हुए बड़े हुए। राम-लक्ष्मण और भरत-शत्रुघ्न में विशेष स्नेह था।
panels.artAction: Exactly four child princes learning at gurukula with Vashishtha; Rama rounder calm blue face, Lakshmana narrower tan face, Bharata cream and Shatrughna teal accents.
panels.narrationEn: The four brothers grew up learning scholarship and the art of arms. Rama and Lakshmana, and Bharata and Shatrughna, shared a special bond.

panels.narration: जब राजकुमार किशोर हुए, महर्षि विश्वामित्र दशरथ के दरबार आए। राजा ने उन्हें सम्मान देकर उनके आगमन का प्रयोजन पूछा।
panels.speaker: दशरथ
panels.dialogue: मुनिवर, मैं आपकी क्या सेवा करूँ?
panels.artAction: Older grey-bearded Vishwamitra arrives at Dasharatha's court; adolescent Rama and Lakshmana stand behind their father, no crowns or exile matted locks.
panels.narrationEn: When the princes reached adolescence, the sage Vishvamitra came to Dasharatha's court. The king honored him and asked the purpose of his visit.
panels.dialogueEn: Great sage, how may I serve you?

episodes.framingEn: Time passes from infancy to adolescence.

episodes.title: पिता का कठिन निर्णय
episodes.framing: राम अभी सोलह वर्ष से छोटे बताए गए हैं।

panels.narration: मारीच और सुबाहु विश्वामित्र के यज्ञ में बाधा डालते थे। मुनि ने रक्षा के लिए राम को अपने साथ भेजने की माँग की।
panels.speaker: विश्वामित्र
panels.dialogue: यज्ञ की रक्षा के लिए राम को भेजिए।
panels.artAction: Vishwamitra explains his disrupted ritual to Dasharatha in court; adolescent Rama listens quietly nearby.
panels.narrationEn: Maricha and Subahu kept disrupting Vishvamitra's yajna. The sage asked that Rama be sent with him for its protection.
panels.dialogueEn: Send Rama to protect the yajna.

panels.narration: दशरथ पुत्र की कम आयु और राक्षसों के बल से डर गए। उन्होंने राम के बदले स्वयं सेना लेकर चलने की बात कही।
panels.speaker: दशरथ
panels.dialogue: राम अभी सोलह वर्ष के भी नहीं हैं।
panels.artAction: Dasharatha's worried close-up as he gestures protectively toward youthful Rama, restrained grief, Vishwamitra firm in foreground.
panels.narrationEn: Dasharatha was afraid, both of his son's young age and the demons' strength. He offered to go himself with an army instead of Rama.
panels.dialogueEn: Rama is not even sixteen years old yet.

panels.narration: विश्वामित्र राजा के पीछे हटने से अप्रसन्न हुए। वसिष्ठ ने समझाया कि वचन निभाएँ; विश्वामित्र राम की रक्षा और शिक्षा कर सकते हैं।
panels.speaker: वसिष्ठ
panels.dialogue: राजन्, अपना दिया वचन निभाइए।
panels.artAction: Gentle Vashishtha mediates between worried Dasharatha and stern narrow-faced Vishwamitra; sages unmistakably distinct.
panels.narrationEn: Vishvamitra was displeased by the king's hesitation. Vashishtha explained that he must keep his word; Vishvamitra could protect and teach Rama.
panels.dialogueEn: O king, keep the word you have given.

panels.narration: वसिष्ठ की बात सुनकर दशरथ सहमत हुए। आशीर्वाद देकर उन्होंने राम और लक्ष्मण को विश्वामित्र के साथ भेजा।
panels.artAction: Dasharatha blesses both adolescent princes at palace departure, Rama calm, Lakshmana alert, Vishwamitra waits with staff; no royal crowns.
panels.narrationEn: Hearing Vashishtha, Dasharatha agreed. He gave his blessing and sent Rama and Lakshmana with Vishvamitra.

episodes.framingEn: Rama is said to be not yet sixteen years old.

episodes.title: पहली वनयात्रा
episodes.framing: वर्तमान यात्रा: अयोध्या से वन की ओर।

panels.narration: सरयू के तट पर विश्वामित्र ने राम को बला और अतिबला विद्याएँ सिखाईं। ये विद्याएँ भूख, थकान और दुर्बलता से रक्षा करती थीं।
panels.artAction: Vishwamitra teaches attentive adolescent Rama beside Sarayu at dusk, Lakshmana listens nearby, grass resting places, bows safely set aside.
panels.narrationEn: On the bank of the Sarayu, Vishvamitra taught Rama the knowledge of Bala and Atibala. These arts protected against hunger, fatigue, and weakness.

panels.narration: संगम के पास ऋषियों ने उनका स्वागत किया। विश्वामित्र ने बताया: यहाँ कामदेव ने शिव का ध्यान भंग करना चाहा था। शिव के क्रोध से वे भस्म हुए; अंग छूटने से यह प्रदेश अंग कहलाया।
panels.artAction: Vishwamitra recounts a legend to the two youths at riverside hermitage, evening lamp and rishis; do not literally depict burning or nudity.
panels.narrationEn: Near the confluence, the sages welcomed them. Vishvamitra told them: here Kamadeva had tried to break Shiva's meditation. In Shiva's wrath he was burned to ash; because his body fell apart here, this region came to be called Anga.

panels.narration: गंगा पार करते समय राम ने संगम की गर्जना पूछी। आगे उजड़े मलद-करूष क्षेत्र में मुनि ने ताड़का के आतंक का परिचय दिया।
panels.speaker: राम
panels.dialogue: यह गर्जना कैसी है, मुनिवर?
panels.artAction: Three travellers cross river in simple boat, Rama asks about rushing confluence; dark forest visible on far bank, no Tataka yet.
panels.narrationEn: While crossing the Ganga, Rama asked about the roar of the confluence. Further on, in the desolate land of Malada-Karusha, the sage described Tataka's terror.
panels.dialogueEn: What is this roar, great sage?

episodes.titleEn: The First Journey into the Forest
episodes.framingEn: The present journey: from Ayodhya toward the forest.

episodes.title: ताड़का का वन
episodes.framing: पहला कठिन सामना।

panels.narration: विश्वामित्र ने बताया कि यक्ष-कन्या ताड़का सुन्द की पत्नी और मारीच की माता थी। शाप के बाद वह इस वन में हिंसा फैलाती थी।
panels.artAction: Vishwamitra describes Tataka's history to the youths at devastated forest edge; threatening two-armed female yaksha visible at distant trees, no attack yet.
panels.narrationEn: Vishvamitra explained that the yaksha maiden Tataka was Sunda's wife and Maricha's mother. After being cursed, she had spread violence through this forest.

panels.narration: राम पहले ताड़का को मारने के बजाय उसकी शक्ति रोकना चाहते थे। विश्वामित्र ने समझाया कि प्रजा की रक्षा करना राजकुमार का कर्तव्य है।
panels.speaker: राम
panels.dialogue: पहले मैं इसकी शक्ति रोकूँगा।
panels.artAction: Youthful Rama thoughtfully readies his bow, Lakshmana stands watch, Vishwamitra gives measured counsel; no triumphant violence.
panels.narrationEn: Rama wanted first to check Tataka's power rather than kill her outright. Vishvamitra explained that protecting the people was a prince's duty.
panels.dialogueEn: First I will check her power.

panels.narration: धनुष की ध्वनि सुनकर ताड़का झपटी। उसने धूल और पत्थरों से प्रहार किया; दोनों भाइयों ने उसका सामना किया।
panels.artAction: Non-graphic action: stormy dust and falling stones, two-armed Tataka lunges through trees, adolescent Rama and Lakshmana defend with bows, no blood or severed limbs.
panels.narrationEn: Hearing the twang of the bow, Tataka charged. She attacked with dust and stones; the two brothers stood against her.

panels.narration: मुनि ने संध्या से पहले संकट समाप्त करने को कहा। राम के बाण से ताड़का मारी गई और वन का भय दूर हुआ।
panels.artAction: Aftermath of Tataka encounter: Rama lowers bow and Vishwamitra reassures both youths as sunlight returns to forest; Tataka obscured at distance, no gore.
panels.narrationEn: The sage told them to end the threat before dusk. Rama's arrow killed Tataka, and the forest's fear lifted.

episodes.framingEn: The first hard encounter.

episodes.title: अस्त्र और सिद्धाश्रम
episodes.framing: शक्ति के साथ संयम की शिक्षा।

panels.narration: विश्वामित्र ने प्रसन्न होकर राम को दिव्यास्त्रों का ज्ञान दिया। राम ने विनयपूर्वक उन्हें स्वीकार किया।
panels.artAction: Vishwamitra instructs youthful Rama; subtle glowing weapon symbols in natural sky, not modern missiles; Lakshmana nearby, dignified lesson.
panels.narrationEn: Pleased, Vishvamitra gave Rama knowledge of the divine weapons. Rama accepted them with humility.

panels.narration: राम ने अस्त्र चलाने के साथ उन्हें वापस लेने की विधि भी पूछी। मुनि ने उनकी संहार-विधि सिखाई।
panels.speaker: राम
panels.dialogue: इन्हें वापस कैसे लिया जाता है?
panels.artAction: Close teaching moment, Rama asks with folded hands and Vishwamitra demonstrates calm recall of a fading luminous arrow; no battle.
panels.narrationEn: Rama asked not only how to release the weapons but how to recall them. The sage taught him the method of withdrawing them.
panels.dialogueEn: How are these recalled?

panels.narration: आश्रम की कथा में विश्वामित्र ने वामन का वर्णन किया: विष्णु ने बलि से तीन पग भूमि माँगी और विराट रूप से लोक नापे।
panels.artAction: Clearly narrated ancient legend: small dignified Vamana with umbrella receives water-gift from King Bali, cosmic horizon suggests three strides without multiple duplicate bodies.
panels.narrationEn: In the story of the hermitage, Vishvamitra described Vamana: Vishnu asked King Bali for three paces of land, then measured the worlds with his cosmic form.

panels.narration: यही सिद्धाश्रम था। राम-लक्ष्मण ने वहाँ के ऋषियों का प्रणाम स्वीकार किया और यज्ञ-रक्षा की तैयारी की।
panels.artAction: Vishwamitra leads two adolescent princes into serene Siddhashrama, resident sages greet them, ritual altar ready but no demons yet.
panels.narrationEn: This was Siddhashrama itself. Rama and Lakshmana received the greetings of the resident sages and prepared to guard the yajna.

episodes.framingEn: A lesson in restraint alongside strength.

episodes.title: यज्ञ की रक्षा
episodes.framing: छह दिन और रात का पहरा।

panels.narration: यज्ञ आरम्भ होने पर विश्वामित्र मौन व्रत में थे। राम और लक्ष्मण ने छह दिन-रात सावधानी से पहरा दिया।
panels.artAction: Youthful Rama and Lakshmana keep watch at Siddhashrama altar while Vishwamitra conducts quiet ritual, twilight, no enemy in frame.
panels.narrationEn: When the yajna began, Vishvamitra observed a vow of silence. Rama and Lakshmana kept careful watch for six days and nights.

panels.narration: अन्तिम दिन मारीच और सुबाहु ने आक्रमण किया। राम के मानवास्त्र ने मारीच को दूर समुद्र की ओर फेंक दिया; वह जीवित बचा।
panels.artAction: Rama releases luminous arrow that carries two-armed Maricha away over treetops; Maricha alive and airborne, no gore, Lakshmana protects sages.
panels.narrationEn: On the last day, Maricha and Subahu attacked. Rama's Manavastra hurled Maricha far off toward the sea; he survived.

panels.narration: सुबाहु का प्रहार जारी रहा। राम ने उसे मार गिराया और शेष आक्रमणकारियों को खदेड़ दिया।
panels.artAction: Rama and Lakshmana halt the remaining raid at ritual clearing, Subahu falls in distant shadow, no blood, protected sages visible.
panels.narrationEn: Subahu's assault continued. Rama struck him down and drove off the remaining attackers.

panels.narration: यज्ञ निर्विघ्न पूर्ण हुआ। ऋषियों ने दोनों भाइयों की प्रशंसा की और विश्वामित्र ने उनके पराक्रम पर सन्तोष प्रकट किया।
panels.speaker: विश्वामित्र
panels.dialogue: तुमने यज्ञ की रक्षा की।
panels.artAction: Relieved Vishwamitra and rishis thank both adolescent brothers beside completed altar at clear sunrise, no lingering enemies.
panels.narrationEn: The yajna was completed without hindrance. The sages praised the two brothers, and Vishvamitra expressed his satisfaction with their valor.
panels.dialogueEn: You have protected the yajna.

episodes.framingEn: Six days and nights of vigil.

episodes.title: मिथिला की राह और पुरानी कथाएँ
episodes.framing: विश्वामित्र यात्रा में अपने कुल का वृत्तान्त सुनाते हैं।

panels.narration: ऋषि जनक के यज्ञ में मिथिला जा रहे थे। राम-लक्ष्मण भी शिवधनुष देखने की इच्छा से उनके साथ चले।
panels.artAction: Travelling party heads toward Mithila through green plains, youthful brothers beside Vishwamitra; Shiva's bow not physically with them.
panels.narrationEn: The sage was going to Mithila for King Janaka's yajna. Rama and Lakshmana went along with him, wishing to see the bow of Shiva.

panels.narration: शोण नदी पर विश्राम के समय विश्वामित्र ने कुश और उनके चार पुत्रों की कथा सुनाई। उन्हीं में राजा कुशनाभ थे।
panels.artAction: Vishwamitra narrates beside Sona river campfire, princes attentive, night stars; story is framed as ancestral account.
panels.narrationEn: While resting by the river Shona, Vishvamitra told the story of Kusha and his four sons. Among them was King Kushanabha.

panels.narration: कुशनाभ की सौ कन्याओं ने कहा कि वे पिता की सहमति के बिना वायु का विवाह-प्रस्ताव स्वीकार नहीं करेंगी। क्रोधित वायु ने उनके शरीर विकृत कर दिए। यह उन पर किया गया अन्याय था।
panels.artAction: Narrated ancestral scene: representative group of adult princess sisters stands united against an imposing wind deity; wind bends their posture gently, no grotesque bodies or mockery.
panels.narrationEn: Kushanabha's hundred daughters said they would not accept the wind-god's marriage proposal without their father's consent. The enraged Vayu twisted their bodies. This was an injustice done to them.

panels.narration: पुत्रियों ने पिता को घटना बताई। कुशनाभ ने उनके धैर्य की सराहना की और उन्हें स्नेह तथा सहारा दिया।
panels.artAction: King Kushanabha compassionately comforts his distressed daughters in court, no blame or humiliation, sisters support each other.
panels.narrationEn: The daughters told their father what had happened. Kushanabha praised their patience and gave them love and support.

panels.narration: कन्याओं का विवाह धर्मशील ब्रह्मदत्त से हुआ। कथा के अनुसार विवाह के समय उनके शरीर फिर स्वस्थ हो गए।
panels.artAction: Ceremonial symbolic wedding of representative princess sisters and King Brahmadatta, restored upright posture, respectful traditional tableau; no sexual imagery.
panels.narrationEn: The daughters were married to the righteous Brahmadatta. According to the story, at the time of the marriage their bodies were restored to health.

panels.narration: कुशनाभ के पुत्र गाधि विश्वामित्र के पिता थे। मुनि ने अपनी बहन सत्यवती और उनके कौशिकी नदीरूप का भी परिचय दिया।
panels.artAction: Return to present riverbank: elder Vishwamitra points toward flowing river while explaining ancestry to youthful Rama and Lakshmana, no unexplained younger duplicate sage.
panels.narrationEn: Kushanabha's son Gadhi was Vishvamitra's father. The sage also told of his sister Satyavati and her form as the river Kaushiki.

episodes.titleEn: The Road to Mithila and Old Tales
episodes.framingEn: On the journey, Vishvamitra recounts the history of his lineage.

episodes.title: गंगा और कार्तिकेय
episodes.framing: गंगा तट पर सुनाई गई देवकथा।

panels.narration: गंगा के तट पर राम ने उनके तीन लोकों में प्रवाह का कारण पूछा। मुनि ने हिमवान की पुत्रियों गंगा और उमा की कथा आरम्भ की।
panels.speaker: राम
panels.dialogue: गंगा तीनों लोकों में कैसे बहती हैं?
panels.artAction: Rama enquires beside broad Ganga, Vishwamitra points toward snow peaks; Lakshmana watches river, no literal three floating rivers.
panels.narrationEn: On the bank of the Ganga, Rama asked why she flows through the three worlds. The sage began the story of Himavan's daughters, Ganga and Uma.
panels.dialogueEn: How does the Ganga flow through all three worlds?

panels.narration: गंगा देवलोक गईं और उमा का विवाह शिव से हुआ। देवताओं के हस्तक्षेप से उमा व्यथित हुईं; दिव्य तेज को अग्नि ने सँभाला।
panels.artAction: Respectful narrated celestial scene: two-armed Shiva and Parvati before concerned gods, Agni contains a symbolic sacred flame; fully clothed, no sexual imagery.
panels.narrationEn: Ganga went to the realm of the gods, and Uma was married to Shiva. The gods' intervention distressed Uma; Agni took on the divine seed.

panels.narration: अग्नि और गंगा के माध्यम से वह तेज शरवण में पहुँचा। वहाँ कुमार का जन्म हुआ और छह कृत्तिकाओं ने उनका पालन किया।
panels.artAction: Sacred reed grove with infant Kartikeya cradled by six distinct motherly Krittikas, Ganga nearby and gentle firelight, no exposed bodies.
panels.narrationEn: Through Agni and Ganga, that fiery seed reached the reed grove of Sharavana. There Kumara was born, and the six Krittikas raised him.

panels.narration: छह कृत्तिकाओं के पालन से कुमार षण्मुख और कार्तिकेय कहलाए। देवताओं ने उन्हें अपना सेनापति बनाया।
panels.artAction: Six-faced youthful Kartikeya stands dignified before gods at ceremonial appointment, six distinct heads including rear profiles, exactly two connected arms for this model.
panels.narrationEn: Raised by the six Krittikas, Kumara came to be called Shanmukha and Kartikeya. The gods made him their commander.

episodes.framingEn: A tale of the gods told on the bank of the Ganga.

episodes.title: सगर के पुत्र और खोया अश्व
episodes.framing: विश्वामित्र राम के पूर्वजों की कथा सुनाते हैं।

panels.narration: राजा सगर को दो रानियों से सन्तान मिली: केशिनी से असमंजस और सुमति से साठ हजार पुत्र। क्रूर आचरण के कारण असमंजस निर्वासित हुआ।
panels.artAction: Narrated ancestral court: older Sagara with two queens, troubled departure of adult Asamanjasa, a symbolic large assembly of other sons, no harm to children.
panels.narrationEn: King Sagara had children by two queens: Asamanjasa from Keshini, and sixty thousand sons from Sumati. Because of his cruel conduct, Asamanjasa was exiled.

panels.narration: सगर के यज्ञ का अश्व इन्द्र ले गए। यज्ञ पूरा करने के लिए राजा ने अपने पुत्रों को उसकी खोज में भेजा।
panels.artAction: Sacrificial white horse disappears toward distant sky under Indra's intervention, Sagara dispatches princes from ritual camp, no animal suffering.
panels.narrationEn: Indra carried off the horse of Sagara's sacrifice. To complete the yajna, the king sent his sons to search for it.

panels.narration: अश्व न मिलने पर पुत्रों ने पृथ्वी खोदनी शुरू की। इससे अनेक जीव व्याकुल हुए; खोजते हुए वे कपिल के आश्रम पहुँचे।
panels.artAction: Sagara's princes excavate vast trenches, worried animals flee safely, distant sage Kapila meditates beside the horse; no destroyed bodies.
panels.narrationEn: Unable to find the horse, the sons began digging into the earth. Many creatures were thrown into distress; searching on, they reached Kapila's hermitage.

panels.narration: पुत्रों ने कपिल को ही चोर मानकर उन पर आक्रमण करना चाहा। उनके क्रोध के तेज से वे भस्म हो गए।
panels.artAction: Kapila remains seated as a blinding non-graphic radiance stops charging princes; aftermath suggested by empty silhouettes, no burning bodies.
panels.narrationEn: Taking Kapila himself for the thief, the sons moved to attack him. By the fire of his anger, they were burned to ashes.

panels.narration: बहुत समय बीतने पर सगर ने पौत्र अंशुमान को भेजा। उसने अश्व और अपने चाचाओं की भस्म देखी तथा तर्पण के लिए जल खोजा।
panels.artAction: Anshuman solemnly finds the living horse near quiet ash mounds, kneels in grief, no corpses; Kapila hermitage distant.
panels.narrationEn: After much time had passed, Sagara sent his grandson Anshuman. He found the horse and the ashes of his uncles, and sought water to offer them libations.

panels.narration: गरुड़ ने बताया कि गंगा के जल से ही उनका उद्धार होगा। अंशुमान अश्व लेकर लौटा और सगर ने यज्ञ पूर्ण किया।
panels.speaker: गरुड़
panels.dialogue: इनके लिए गंगा का जल आवश्यक है।
panels.artAction: Garuda with one pair of wings and two arms counsels grieving Anshuman beside horse; no conflating Anshuman with later Bhagiratha.
panels.narrationEn: Garuda told him that only the waters of the Ganga could redeem them. Anshuman returned with the horse, and Sagara completed the yajna.
panels.dialogueEn: The waters of the Ganga are needed for them.

episodes.titleEn: Sagara's Sons and the Lost Horse
episodes.framingEn: Vishvamitra tells the story of Rama's ancestors.

episodes.title: भगीरथ और गंगा का अवतरण
episodes.framing: कई पीढ़ियाँ बीतती हैं; भगीरथ की कथा।

panels.narration: सगर के बाद अंशुमान और दिलीप भी गंगा को नहीं ला सके। दिलीप के पुत्र भगीरथ ने यह कार्य पूरा करने का निश्चय किया।
panels.artAction: Young adult royal Bhagiratha contemplates ancestral memorial by palace river terrace, successive generations indicated through dignified ancestral portraits, no Rama here.
panels.narrationEn: After Sagara, neither Anshuman nor Dilipa could bring down the Ganga. Dilipa's son Bhagiratha resolved to accomplish the task.

panels.narration: भगीरथ की तपस्या से ब्रह्मा प्रसन्न हुए। उन्होंने कहा कि गंगा का प्रबल वेग पृथ्वी नहीं सँभाल सकती; शिव की सहायता आवश्यक है।
panels.speaker: ब्रह्मा
panels.dialogue: गंगा का वेग शिव ही सँभाल सकते हैं।
panels.artAction: Ascetic Bhagiratha receives blessing from four-headed Brahma beneath Himalaya sky; rushing celestial river implied above.
panels.narrationEn: Brahma was pleased by Bhagiratha's penance. He said the earth could not bear the Ganga's mighty force; Shiva's help was needed.
panels.dialogueEn: Only Shiva can bear the force of the Ganga.

panels.narration: भगीरथ ने शिव को प्रसन्न किया। गंगा के उतरने पर शिव ने उनका वेग अपनी जटाओं में धारण कर लिया।
panels.artAction: Shiva with two arms and third eye catches descending Ganga in vast matted locks, Bhagiratha prays below, full river flow and dignity, no tiny floating person in hair.
panels.narrationEn: Bhagiratha won Shiva's favor. When the Ganga descended, Shiva caught her force in his matted locks.

panels.narration: भगीरथ की प्रार्थना पर शिव ने गंगा को मुक्त किया। धारा सात मार्गों में बँटी और एक धारा भगीरथ के पीछे चली।
panels.artAction: Ganga flows from Shiva's locks into mountain lake then branches; Bhagiratha leads one stream through valley in chariot, no ocean bridge.
panels.narrationEn: At Bhagiratha's prayer, Shiva released the Ganga. The stream divided into seven courses, and one followed behind Bhagiratha.

panels.narration: वेगवती गंगा ने जह्नु का यज्ञस्थल डुबो दिया। क्रोधित ऋषि ने नदी को पी लिया और उसका प्रवाह रुक गया।
panels.artAction: Sage Jahnu at flooded altar stops rushing stream by divine gesture, river gathers into symbolic water glow; no grotesque drinking anatomy.
panels.narrationEn: The swift Ganga flooded the sage Jahnu's sacrificial ground. The enraged sage drank up the river, and its flow stopped.

panels.narration: देवताओं की प्रार्थना पर जह्नु ने गंगा को फिर प्रवाहित किया। इस सम्बन्ध से वे जाह्नवी भी कहलायीं और आगे बढ़ीं।
panels.artAction: Jahnu releases clear river gently toward waiting Bhagiratha, grateful celestial figures, respectful symbolic flow rather than bodily close-up.
panels.narrationEn: At the gods' prayer, Jahnu let the Ganga flow again. Through this bond she also came to be called Jahnavi, and continued on her way.

panels.narration: गंगा का जल सगरपुत्रों की भस्म तक पहुँचा। उनके उद्धार का कार्य पूरा हुआ और भगीरथ ने पूर्वजों का तर्पण किया।
panels.artAction: Bhagiratha offers water as Ganga reaches ancestral ash mounds, peaceful luminous atmosphere, no literal corpses rising or ghost crowd.
panels.narrationEn: The waters of the Ganga reached the ashes of Sagara's sons. Their redemption was accomplished, and Bhagiratha offered libations to his ancestors.

panels.narration: ब्रह्मा ने भगीरथ के प्रयास की प्रशंसा की। विश्वामित्र ने कथा समाप्त की; राम-लक्ष्मण आगे की यात्रा के लिए तैयार हुए।
panels.artAction: Return to current journey: Rama and Lakshmana listen with wonder to elder Vishwamitra beside Ganga at dawn, no adult crowned Rama.
panels.narrationEn: Brahma praised Bhagiratha's effort. Vishvamitra finished the story; Rama and Lakshmana made ready to continue the journey.

episodes.titleEn: Bhagiratha and the Descent of the Ganga
episodes.framingEn: Several generations pass; the story of Bhagiratha.

episodes.title: समुद्र-मंथन और विशालापुरी
episodes.framing: विशाला के मार्ग पर एक और पुराकथा।

panels.narration: विशाला के निकट विश्वामित्र ने देवों और दैत्यों के समुद्र-मंथन की कथा सुनाई। वे अमृत पाने के लिए साथ जुटे थे।
panels.artAction: Present travel: Vishwamitra introduces distant Vishala city to princes beside a grove, beginning another clearly framed ancient legend.
panels.narrationEn: Near Vishala, Vishvamitra told the story of the gods and demons churning the ocean. They had come together to obtain the nectar of immortality.

panels.narration: मन्दर पर्वत मथानी और वासुकि रस्सी बने। पर्वत डूबने लगा तो विष्णु ने कूर्मरूप से उसे आधार दिया।
panels.artAction: Mythic ocean churning with mountain on a single giant tortoise, gods and asuras pull one serpent in opposite directions, wide coherent composition.
panels.narrationEn: Mount Mandara became the churning rod and Vasuki the rope. When the mountain began to sink, Vishnu, in the form of a tortoise, held it up.

panels.narration: मंथन से घातक हलाहल निकला। लोकों को संकट में देखकर शिव ने विष धारण किया और विनाश टला।
panels.artAction: Two-armed Shiva compassionately contains poison from ocean in a small vessel, blue throat, gods relieved, no suffering or gore.
panels.narrationEn: The churning produced the lethal poison Halahala. Seeing the worlds in peril, Shiva drank the poison, and disaster was averted.

panels.narration: मंथन से धन्वन्तरि, अप्सराएँ, वारुणी और अमृत प्रकट हुए। अमृत को लेकर देवों और दैत्यों में विवाद हुआ।
panels.artAction: Dhanvantari rises respectfully from milky ocean carrying nectar pot, celestial treasures and Varuni at a distance; no modern medical objects.
panels.narrationEn: The churning brought forth Dhanvantari, the apsaras, Varuni, and the nectar of immortality. A dispute arose between the gods and the demons over the nectar.

panels.narration: विष्णु की सहायता से देवताओं को अमृत मिला। संघर्ष के बाद देवता विजयी हुए; कथा आगे दिति के दुःख की ओर मुड़ी।
panels.artAction: Gods receive nectar under Vishnu's guidance while asuras withdraw across ocean shore, no graphic battle, no unsupported duplicated Mohini tableau.
panels.narrationEn: With Vishnu's help, the gods obtained the nectar. After the struggle, the gods were victorious; the story then turned to Diti's sorrow.

episodes.titleEn: The Churning of the Ocean and Vishalapuri
episodes.framingEn: Another old tale, told on the road to Vishala.

episodes.title: दिति और मरुत
episodes.framing: प्रतिशोध की कामना से समझौते तक।

panels.narration: पुत्रों के वियोग से दुःखी दिति ने इन्द्र को हराने वाला पुत्र चाहा। कश्यप ने उन्हें कठोर व्रत का नियम बताया।
panels.artAction: Grieving fully clothed Diti speaks with sage Kashyapa at forest hermitage, sorrow and anger restrained, no unborn-child imagery.
panels.narrationEn: Grieving the loss of her sons, Diti wished for a son who could defeat Indra. Kashyapa told her the discipline of a strict vow.

panels.narration: अपने वध के भय से इन्द्र दिति की सेवा करते हुए अवसर देखते रहे। व्रत में चूक होने पर उन्होंने गर्भ को सात भागों में बाँट दिया।
panels.artAction: Symbolic non-graphic episode: resting Diti at hermitage, remorseful Indra beside seven separated points of light in sky; no visible pregnancy injury, blood or foetus.
panels.narrationEn: Fearing his own death, Indra served Diti while watching for an opportunity. When she faltered in her vow, he split the womb into seven parts.

panels.narration: दिति ने उन सात अंशों को मरुत देवताओं का स्थान देने को कहा। इन्द्र ने स्वीकार किया और दोनों के बीच समझौता हुआ।
panels.artAction: Diti and Indra reconcile under luminous seven wind-spirits, compassionate expressions, no infant fragments or violence.
panels.narrationEn: Diti asked that the seven fragments be given the status of the Marut gods. Indra agreed, and a reconciliation took place between them.

panels.narration: इसी प्रदेश में विशाल नामक राजा की नगरी बसी थी। उसके वंशज सुमति ने विश्वामित्र और दोनों राजकुमारों का स्वागत किया।
panels.artAction: King Sumati welcomes Vishwamitra and adolescent Rama and Lakshmana at Vishala gate, distinct from Sagara's queen Sumati.
panels.narrationEn: In this same region stood the city of a king named Vishala. His descendant Sumati welcomed Vishvamitra and the two princes.

episodes.framingEn: From the wish for revenge to reconciliation.

episodes.title: अहल्या का आश्रम
episodes.framing: वर्तमान यात्रा में गौतम-अहल्या की पुरानी घटना का परिचय।

panels.narration: विशाला से आगे एक सूना आश्रम मिला। विश्वामित्र ने बताया कि यहाँ कभी गौतम और अहल्या रहते थे।
panels.speaker: राम
panels.dialogue: यह आश्रम इतना सूना क्यों है?
panels.artAction: Youthful Rama asks Vishwamitra about deserted hermitage, Lakshmana looks at overgrown path, no stone statue.
panels.narrationEn: Beyond Vishala they came upon a deserted hermitage. Vishvamitra told them that Gautama and Ahalya had once lived there.
panels.dialogueEn: Why is this hermitage so deserted?

panels.narration: इन्द्र गौतम का रूप धरकर अहल्या के पास आए। अहल्या उन्हें पहचानती थीं, फिर भी उन्हें स्वीकार किया। गौतम लौटे तो क्रोधित होकर दोनों को शाप दिया।
panels.artAction: Restrained narrated flashback: Gautama confronts disguised Indra outside hermitage, fully clothed Ahalya stands at doorway; no intimacy or nudity.
panels.narrationEn: Indra took Gautama's form and came to Ahalya. Ahalya recognized him, yet still accepted him. When Gautama returned, he cursed them both in his anger.

panels.narration: अहल्या को अदृश्य रहकर तप करना था; राम के आगमन पर शाप समाप्त होना था।
panels.artAction: Symbolic unseen Ahalya represented only by soft luminous outline in quiet hermitage, not a stone woman; no Rama stepping on stone.
panels.narrationEn: Ahalya was to remain invisible and perform penance; the curse was to end with Rama's arrival.

panels.narration: राम-लक्ष्मण आश्रम में आए और अहल्या प्रकट हुईं। दोनों ने उनका आदर किया; अहल्या ने अतिथियों का सत्कार किया।
panels.artAction: Ahalya, fully visible and dignified, welcomes youthful Rama and Lakshmana with water vessel; both bow respectfully, Vishwamitra behind.
panels.narrationEn: Rama and Lakshmana entered the hermitage, and Ahalya appeared. Both honored her; Ahalya welcomed her guests.

panels.narration: गौतम भी लौटे और अहल्या से पुनर्मिलन हुआ। उनका आशीर्वाद लेकर विश्वामित्र तथा दोनों भाई मिथिला की ओर बढ़े।
panels.artAction: Gautama and Ahalya reunited peacefully at hermitage, bless departing two princes and elder Vishwamitra; no magical stone debris.
panels.narrationEn: Gautama too returned and was reunited with Ahalya. Taking their blessing, Vishvamitra and the two brothers went on toward Mithila.

episodes.framingEn: On the present journey, the old story of Gautama and Ahalya is introduced.

episodes.title: मिथिला और शतानन्द
episodes.framing: शतानन्द विश्वामित्र के पूर्वजीवन की कथा सुनाते हैं।

panels.narration: मिथिला में राजा जनक ने विश्वामित्र का स्वागत किया। मुनि ने राम-लक्ष्मण का परिचय और उनकी यज्ञ-रक्षा का समाचार दिया।
panels.artAction: Bearded narrow-crowned Janaka greets elder Vishwamitra and two adolescent princes at Mithila ritual pavilion, Sita not yet meeting Rama.
panels.narrationEn: In Mithila, King Janaka welcomed Vishvamitra. The sage introduced Rama and Lakshmana and told of their defense of the yajna.

panels.narration: जनक के पुरोहित शतानन्द, गौतम और अहल्या के पुत्र थे। माता के शापमुक्त होने का समाचार सुनकर वे प्रसन्न हुए।
panels.speaker: शतानन्द
panels.dialogue: मेरी माता का सत्कार स्वीकार हुआ?
panels.artAction: Shatananda gratefully asks Vishwamitra about his mother Ahalya while Rama and Lakshmana listen, Janaka nearby.
panels.narrationEn: Shatananda, Janaka's priest, was the son of Gautama and Ahalya. He was overjoyed to hear that his mother was freed from her curse.
panels.dialogueEn: Was my mother received with honor?

panels.narration: शतानन्द ने राम को उनके गुरु का पुराना जीवन सुनाना शुरू किया। विश्वामित्र पहले राजा थे; तप और आत्मसंयम से महर्षि बने।
panels.artAction: Shatananda tells the story to youthful Rama in Mithila pavilion; do not place young King Vishwamitra physically among present-day listeners.
panels.narrationEn: Shatananda began telling Rama the earlier life of his teacher. Vishvamitra had once been a king; through penance and self-discipline he became a great sage.

episodes.framingEn: Shatananda tells the story of Vishvamitra's earlier life.

episodes.title: राजा कौशिक और शबला
episodes.framing: शतानन्द की कथा: विश्वामित्र का पूर्वजीवन।

panels.narration: राजा विश्वामित्र अपनी सेना सहित वसिष्ठ के आश्रम पहुँचे। वसिष्ठ ने शबला की सहायता से सबके लिए भोजन की व्यवस्था की।
panels.artAction: Narrated past: younger royal black-bearded Vishwamitra and soldiers receive abundant feast from Vashishtha's sacred cow Shabala at hermitage.
panels.narrationEn: King Vishvamitra arrived at Vashishtha's hermitage with his army. With Shabala's help, Vashishtha arranged food for everyone.

panels.narration: शबला की शक्ति देखकर राजा उसे लेना चाहते थे। उन्होंने धन दिया, पर वसिष्ठ ने कहा कि गौ उनके आश्रम के कार्यों का आधार है।
panels.speaker: वसिष्ठ
panels.dialogue: शबला को मैं नहीं दे सकता।
panels.artAction: Royal Vishwamitra offers riches for a single sacred cow; gentle Vashishtha refuses firmly, Shabala between them.
panels.narrationEn: Seeing Shabala's power, the king wanted to take her. He offered wealth, but Vashishtha said the cow was the foundation of his hermitage's work.
panels.dialogueEn: I cannot give you Shabala.

panels.narration: राजा ने शबला को बलपूर्वक ले जाना चाहा। वह वसिष्ठ के पास लौटी और सहायता माँगी; मुनि ने उसे रक्षा की अनुमति दी।
panels.artAction: Shabala pulls free from soldiers and returns to Vashishtha, royal Vishwamitra frustrated, no cruel restraint or injury visible.
panels.narrationEn: The king tried to take Shabala by force. She returned to Vashishtha and asked for help; the sage gave her leave to defend herself.

panels.narration: शबला से उत्पन्न सेनाओं ने राजा की सेना को परास्त किया। उनके अनेक पुत्र भी मारे गए; विश्वामित्र गहरे शोक और क्रोध में डूबे।
panels.artAction: Non-graphic aftermath of battle at hermitage: defeated royal Vishwamitra kneels among discarded shields, Shabala and Vashishtha protected in distance, no bodies or gore.
panels.narrationEn: Armies born from Shabala defeated the king's forces. Many of his sons were also killed; Vishvamitra sank into deep grief and anger.

panels.narration: विश्वामित्र ने तप करके शिव से दिव्यास्त्र पाए। फिर वे बदला लेने वसिष्ठ के आश्रम लौटे और उस पर प्रहार किया।
panels.artAction: Younger ascetic Vishwamitra receives weapon knowledge from two-armed Shiva, bow set aside; austere mountains, no adult Rama.
panels.narrationEn: Through penance, Vishvamitra obtained divine weapons from Shiva. Then he returned to Vashishtha's hermitage for revenge and attacked him.

panels.narration: वसिष्ठ के ब्रह्मदण्ड ने सारे अस्त्र निष्प्रभाव कर दिए। राजा समझ गए कि बाहुबल से अधिक बल तप और साधना में है।
panels.artAction: Vashishtha's simple staff calmly absorbs radiant weapon trails launched by younger Vishwamitra, no modern lasers or explosions, hermitage spared in focal area.
panels.narrationEn: Vashishtha's Brahmadanda rendered all the weapons powerless. The king understood that there was greater strength in penance and discipline than in physical might.

panels.narration: पराजय के बाद विश्वामित्र ने राज्यबल के अभिमान से हटकर कठोर तप का मार्ग चुना। उनका लक्ष्य ब्रह्मर्षि बनना था।
panels.speaker: विश्वामित्र
panels.dialogue: अब मैं तप और संयम का मार्ग लूँगा।
panels.artAction: Younger Vishwamitra leaves royal crown and armour behind and walks into forest with simple ascetic staff, determined introspection.
panels.narrationEn: After his defeat, Vishvamitra turned away from the pride of royal power and chose the path of hard penance. His goal was to become a Brahmarshi.
panels.dialogueEn: Now I will take the path of penance and discipline.

episodes.framingEn: Shatananda's tale: Vishvamitra's earlier life.

episodes.title: त्रिशंकु की कथा
episodes.framing: अभी शतानन्द की सुनाई हुई पुराकथा जारी है।

panels.narration: तप के बाद विश्वामित्र को राजर्षि कहा गया, पर वे और आगे बढ़ना चाहते थे। इसी समय राजा त्रिशंकु ने सशरीर स्वर्ग जाने की इच्छा की।
panels.artAction: Trishanku in royal court petitions Vashishtha, while story context is Vishwamitra's ascetic period; no modern throne or wings.
panels.narrationEn: After his penance, Vishvamitra was called a Rajarshi, but he wished to advance further still. At this time, King Trishanku desired to go to heaven in his own body.

panels.narration: वसिष्ठ ने इस अनुष्ठान को अस्वीकार किया। त्रिशंकु उनके पुत्रों के पास गए; उनके शाप से राजा का रूप बदल गया।
panels.artAction: Vashishtha's adult ascetic sons reject Trishanku, who loses royal splendour and appears travel-worn; do not depict caste through darker skin or degrading caricature.
panels.narrationEn: Vashishtha refused to perform this rite. Trishanku went to his sons; their curse changed the king's form.

panels.narration: सहारा खो चुके त्रिशंकु विश्वामित्र के पास पहुँचे। मुनि ने उनकी दशा सुनी और सहायता का वचन दिया।
panels.speaker: त्रिशंकु
panels.dialogue: अब मैं आपकी शरण में आया हूँ।
panels.artAction: Travel-worn uncrowned Trishanku appeals to middle-aged ascetic Vishwamitra in forest, compassionate reception.
panels.narrationEn: Having lost all support, Trishanku came to Vishvamitra. The sage heard his plight and promised to help.
panels.dialogueEn: Now I have come to seek refuge with you.

panels.narration: विश्वामित्र ने ऋषियों को यज्ञ में बुलाया। कुछ ने उपहास कर आने से मना किया; क्रोध में मुनि ने उन्हें भी शाप दिया।
panels.artAction: Vishwamitra hears disrespectful refusal from messenger at ritual ground, anger on face, gathered sages concerned; no literal destruction of humans.
panels.narrationEn: Vishvamitra invited the sages to the yajna. Some mocked him and refused to come; in anger, the sage cursed them too.

panels.narration: यज्ञ के बल से त्रिशंकु ऊपर उठे, पर इन्द्र ने उन्हें लौटा दिया। वे सिर नीचे किए गिरने लगे और विश्वामित्र से पुकार की।
panels.speaker: त्रिशंकु
panels.dialogue: मुनिवर, मेरी रक्षा कीजिए!
panels.artAction: Trishanku falls upside down through starry sky toward distant earth, fully clothed, terrified but unharmed; not floating upright in heaven.
panels.narrationEn: By the power of the yajna, Trishanku rose upward, but Indra sent him back down. He began falling head-first and cried out to Vishvamitra.
panels.dialogueEn: Great sage, save me!

panels.narration: विश्वामित्र ने उन्हें गिरते हुए रोक दिया और नए नक्षत्र रचने लगे। देवताओं से समझौते पर त्रिशंकु उसी आकाशीय स्थिति में रहे।
panels.artAction: Vishwamitra raises hand beneath an upside-down Trishanku held motionless among new stars, gods approach peacefully, single coherent figure in sky.
panels.narrationEn: Vishvamitra halted his fall and began creating new constellations. By agreement with the gods, Trishanku remained in that same position in the sky.

episodes.framingEn: Shatananda's telling of the old story continues.

episodes.title: शुनःशेप की रक्षा
episodes.framing: एक बालक की प्रार्थना और जीवनरक्षा।

panels.narration: राजा अम्बरीष का यज्ञपशु इन्द्र ले गए। पुरोहितों ने विकल्प माँगा, जिससे एक बालक का जीवन संकट में पड़ गया।
panels.artAction: Ambarisha worries at empty animal tether beside ritual ground, priests confer gravely; no child tied or harmed in this setup.
panels.narrationEn: Indra carried off King Ambarisha's sacrificial animal. The priests demanded a substitute, which put a boy's life in danger.

panels.narration: ऋचीक और उनके परिवार से बात कर अम्बरीष मध्यम पुत्र शुनःशेप को साथ ले गए। बालक को अनुष्ठान में बलि बनाए जाने का भय था।
panels.artAction: Shunahshepa, a fully clothed frightened child, leaves parents with King Ambarisha; no weapons, chains or violence, emotionally restrained scene.
panels.narrationEn: After speaking with Richika and his family, Ambarisha took the middle son, Shunahshepa, with him. The boy feared being sacrificed in the ritual.

panels.narration: पुष्कर में शुनःशेप ने अपने सम्बन्धी विश्वामित्र की शरण ली। उसने माता-पिता और राजा के निर्णय के बीच अपनी असहायता बताई।
panels.speaker: शुनःशेप
panels.dialogue: मुनिवर, मेरे जीवन की रक्षा कीजिए।
panels.artAction: Shunahshepa clings to seated ascetic Vishwamitra beside Pushkara lake, who listens protectively, Ambarisha waits at respectful distance.
panels.narrationEn: At Pushkara, Shunahshepa sought refuge with his kinsman Vishvamitra. He explained his helplessness, caught between his parents' and the king's decision.
panels.dialogueEn: Great sage, save my life.

panels.narration: विश्वामित्र के पुत्र उसके स्थान पर जाने को तैयार न हुए। क्रोधित मुनि ने उन्हें शाप दिया, फिर बालक को रक्षा की प्रार्थनाएँ सिखाईं।
panels.artAction: Vishwamitra teaches prayers to Shunahshepa after his adult sons withdraw, compassion toward child contrasted with checked anger; no ritual harm.
panels.narrationEn: Vishvamitra's own sons refused to go in his place. In anger, the sage cursed them, then taught the boy prayers for protection.

panels.narration: यज्ञ में शुनःशेप ने सिखाई प्रार्थनाएँ कीं। इन्द्र ने प्रसन्न होकर उसे दीर्घायु दी; अम्बरीष का अनुष्ठान भी पूरा हुआ और बालक बच गया।
panels.artAction: Shunahshepa stands safe and free near altar, hands joined in prayer, Ambarisha relieved and Vishwamitra's protection remembered; no injury or sacrificial act.
panels.narrationEn: At the yajna, Shunahshepa recited the prayers he had been taught. Pleased, Indra granted him long life; Ambarisha's rite was also completed, and the boy was saved.

episodes.framingEn: A boy's prayer and the saving of his life.

episodes.title: मन की विजय
episodes.framing: विश्वामित्र का तप बाहरी शक्ति से आत्मसंयम की ओर बढ़ता है।

panels.narration: अप्सरा मेनका पुष्कर सरोवर आईं। विश्वामित्र तप से विमुख होकर वर्षों उनके साथ रहे। फिर उन्हें अपने लक्ष्य से हटने का बोध हुआ।
panels.artAction: Respectful fully clothed Menaka and younger ascetic Vishwamitra converse beside tranquil lake, time passing suggested by seasons, no intimacy.
panels.narrationEn: The apsara Menaka came to Lake Pushkara. Vishvamitra turned away from his penance and lived with her for years. Then he realized he had strayed from his goal.

panels.narration: विश्वामित्र ने मेनका को शान्तिपूर्वक विदा किया और पुनः तप करने लगे। महर्षि पद पाकर भी वे पूर्ण इन्द्रिय-संयम साधना चाहते थे।
panels.artAction: Vishwamitra gently bids farewell to Menaka and turns toward snow mountains with staff, regret and resolve, no hostility.
panels.narrationEn: Vishvamitra parted from Menaka peacefully and resumed his penance. Even after attaining the rank of Maharshi, he wished to master complete control over the senses.

panels.narration: इन्द्र ने रम्भा को तप भंग करने भेजा। विश्वामित्र ने पहचानकर उसे शाप दे दिया, पर अपने क्रोध से तप का क्षय भी हुआ।
panels.artAction: Fully clothed Rambha freezes in sorrow before angry ascetic Vishwamitra, symbolic stone-like stillness only, no violent punishment or erotic pose.
panels.narrationEn: Indra sent Rambha to break his penance. Vishvamitra recognized her and cursed her, but his anger also diminished his penance.

panels.narration: विश्वामित्र को समझ आया कि क्रोध पर विजय बाकी है। उन्होंने मौन और धैर्य का कठोर व्रत लिया।
panels.speaker: विश्वामित्र
panels.dialogue: मुझे अपने क्रोध को भी जीतना होगा।
panels.artAction: Solitary ageing Vishwamitra meditates calmly beneath tree, face softer and beard greying, broken anger replaced by discipline.
panels.narrationEn: Vishvamitra realized that victory over anger still remained. He took up a strict vow of silence and patience.
panels.dialogueEn: I must conquer my anger too.

panels.narration: इन्द्र ब्राह्मण का रूप लेकर भोजन माँगने आए। विश्वामित्र ने अपना समस्त भोजन दे दिया और बिना क्रोध तप जारी रखा।
panels.artAction: Disguised Indra as ordinary brahmin receives Vishwamitra's entire simple food bowl; older greying sage gives serenely, no visible Indra crown.
panels.narrationEn: Indra came in the form of a brahmin to beg for food. Vishvamitra gave away all his food and continued his penance without anger.

panels.narration: अन्ततः ब्रह्मा ने उन्हें ब्रह्मर्षि कहा और वसिष्ठ ने भी स्वीकार किया। शतानन्द ने कथा समाप्त की; अब राम शिवधनुष देखने वाले थे।
panels.artAction: Elder grey-bearded Vishwamitra and gentle Vashishtha greet one another with mutual respect, Brahma blesses above; reconciliation not combat.
panels.narrationEn: At last Brahma proclaimed him a Brahmarshi, and Vashishtha too accepted it. Shatananda ended the story; now Rama was to see the bow of Shiva.

episodes.framingEn: Vishvamitra's penance moves from outward power toward self-mastery.

episodes.title: शिवधनुष और सीता
episodes.framing: वर्तमान मिथिला लौटते हैं।

panels.narration: जनक ने अपने कुल में सुरक्षित शिवधनुष का इतिहास सुनाया। यह देवताओं से उनके पूर्वज देवरात को धरोहर में मिला था।
panels.artAction: Janaka explains the massive unstrung sacred Shiva bow resting in an iron chest on eight-wheeled cart, Vishwamitra and adolescent princes listen.
panels.narrationEn: Janaka told the history of the bow of Shiva, kept safe in his lineage. It had come to his ancestor Devarata as a trust from the gods.

panels.narration: जनक ने बताया कि यज्ञभूमि जोतते हुए उन्हें सीता मिली थीं। उन्होंने उन्हें पुत्री की तरह पाला और उनका नाम सीता रखा।
panels.artAction: Narrated flashback: younger Janaka finds a safely wrapped infant girl in a ploughed furrow at cultivated sacred field, no neglect or injury.
panels.narrationEn: Janaka told how he had found Sita while ploughing the sacrificial ground. He raised her as his own daughter and named her Sita.

panels.narration: जनक ने धनुष पर प्रत्यंचा चढ़ाने वाले से सीता के विवाह का निश्चय किया था। पहले आए राजा असफल हुए और उनका आक्रमण भी निष्फल रहा।
panels.artAction: Present Janaka speaks thoughtfully beside unstrung sacred bow, youthful Sita watches from distant gallery; no simultaneous contest or Ravana cameo.
panels.narrationEn: Janaka had decided to marry Sita to whoever could string the bow. The kings who had come before failed, and even their assault proved fruitless.

panels.narration: सेवक भारी धनुष लाए। विश्वामित्र की अनुमति से राम ने उसे देखने, उठाने और प्रत्यंचा चढ़ाने के लिए हाथ बढ़ाया।
panels.speaker: विश्वामित्र
panels.dialogue: वत्स राम, यह धनुष देखो।
panels.artAction: Youthful broad-faced blue Rama approaches enormous sacred bow on wheeled chest, narrow-faced Lakshmana and elder Vishwamitra watch, no crown.
panels.narrationEn: Attendants brought the heavy bow. With Vishvamitra's permission, Rama reached out to look at it, lift it, and string it.
panels.dialogueEn: Child Rama, look at this bow.

panels.narration: राम ने धनुष सहज उठाकर प्रत्यंचा चढ़ाई। खींचते समय वह टूट गया; उसकी गूँज से सभा स्तब्ध रह गई।
panels.artAction: Rama strings enormous bow as it snaps cleanly at centre, two broken limbs visible, court astonished, no injury, no duplicate bow in hands.
panels.narrationEn: Rama lifted the bow with ease and strung it. As he drew it, it broke; its resounding crash left the assembly stunned.

panels.narration: जनक ने सीता का विवाह राम से करने का प्रस्ताव रखा। विश्वामित्र की सहमति लेकर उन्होंने दशरथ को बुलाने के लिए दूत भेजे।
panels.speaker: जनक
panels.dialogue: मैं सीता का विवाह राम से करूँगा।
panels.artAction: Janaka respectfully discusses proposal with Vishwamitra while two youthful princes stand nearby; Sita dignified in balcony, messenger departs.
panels.narrationEn: Janaka proposed Sita's marriage to Rama. With Vishvamitra's consent, he sent messengers to summon Dasharatha.
panels.dialogueEn: I shall give Sita in marriage to Rama.

episodes.titleEn: The Bow of Shiva and Sita
episodes.framingEn: We return to the present in Mithila.

episodes.title: विवाह का संदेश
episodes.framing: अयोध्या और मिथिला के परिवार मिलते हैं।

panels.narration: दूत अयोध्या पहुँचे। उन्होंने धनुष-भंग, दोनों राजकुमारों की कुशलता और जनक के विवाह-प्रस्ताव का समाचार सुनाया।
panels.artAction: Mithila messengers report joyfully to Dasharatha, Vashishtha and two younger princes Bharata and Shatrughna in Ayodhya court.
panels.narrationEn: The messengers reached Ayodhya. They reported the breaking of the bow, the well-being of both princes, and Janaka's proposal of marriage.

panels.narration: दशरथ ने गुरुओं और मन्त्रियों से परामर्श किया। सहमति मिलने पर वे भरत-शत्रुघ्न और राजपरिवार के साथ मिथिला के लिए चले।
panels.artAction: Dasharatha's royal caravan travels across plains with Vashishtha, Bharata and Shatrughna, no Rama or Lakshmana in this caravan.
panels.narrationEn: Dasharatha consulted his gurus and ministers. Once agreement was reached, he set out for Mithila with Bharata, Shatrughna, and the royal family.

panels.narration: मिथिला में जनक ने दशरथ का स्वागत किया। राजा अपने दोनों पुत्रों से मिले और विवाह की तैयारी आगे बढ़ी।
panels.artAction: Dasharatha warmly embraces youthful Rama and Lakshmana as Janaka welcomes the Ayodhya party, Bharata and Shatrughna beside them, exactly four princes.
panels.narrationEn: In Mithila, Janaka welcomed Dasharatha. The king was reunited with his two sons, and preparations for the wedding went forward.

episodes.framingEn: The families of Ayodhya and Mithila come together.

episodes.title: दो कुल और चार सम्बन्ध
episodes.framing: परिवारों का परिचय और विवाह की सहमति।

panels.narration: जनक ने अपने भाई कुशध्वज को बुलाया। वसिष्ठ ने इक्ष्वाकु से दशरथ तक राम के कुल का परिचय दिया।
panels.artAction: Vashishtha recites lineage before Dasharatha, Janaka and younger royal Kushadhvaja in Mithila assembly, ancestral banners symbolic not readable text.
panels.narrationEn: Janaka summoned his brother Kushadhvaja. Vashishtha recounted Rama's lineage from Ikshvaku down to Dasharatha.

panels.narration: जनक ने निमि से अपने कुल का वृत्तान्त सुनाया। उन्होंने राम के लिए सीता और लक्ष्मण के लिए अपनी दूसरी पुत्री ऊर्मिला का प्रस्ताव रखा।
panels.artAction: Janaka introduces Sita in red and Urmila in leaf green respectfully to assembled families, young Rama and Lakshmana stand separately.
panels.narrationEn: Janaka recounted his own lineage from Nimi. He proposed Sita for Rama and his second daughter, Urmila, for Lakshmana.

panels.narration: विश्वामित्र और वसिष्ठ ने कुशध्वज की पुत्रियों माण्डवी तथा श्रुतकीर्ति के विवाह भरत और शत्रुघ्न से करने का प्रस्ताव दिया। परिवारों ने सहमति दी।
panels.artAction: Kushadhvaja presents Mandavi in plum and Shrutakirti in turquoise, Bharata cream and Shatrughna teal opposite, two sages bless proposed matches.
panels.narrationEn: Vishvamitra and Vashishtha proposed that Kushadhvaja's daughters, Mandavi and Shrutakirti, be married to Bharata and Shatrughna. The families agreed.

panels.narration: विवाह का शुभ समय तय हुआ। दशरथ ने पुत्रों के संस्कार कराए और गौ, वस्त्र तथा धन का दान किया।
panels.artAction: Dasharatha gives cows and cloth respectfully to guests and priests while exactly four princes undergo simple pre-wedding rites, no exchange of brides for goods.
panels.narrationEn: An auspicious time for the weddings was fixed. Dasharatha had the rites performed for his sons and gave gifts of cows, cloth, and wealth.

episodes.framingEn: The families are introduced, and the marriages are agreed upon.

episodes.title: चार विवाह
episodes.framing: चारों जोड़ों की पहचान अलग रहती है।

panels.narration: भरत के मामा युधाजित भी मिथिला पहुँचे। वे अयोध्या में भाँजों के विषय में सुनकर विवाह-समारोह में आए थे।
panels.artAction: Yudhajit greets nephew Bharata and Dasharatha at Mithila wedding entrance, Shatrughna nearby, no confused paternal relation.
panels.narrationEn: Bharata's maternal uncle Yudhajit also arrived in Mithila. Hearing in Ayodhya about his nephews, he had come for the wedding ceremony.

panels.narration: अग्नि के सामने जनक ने सीता का हाथ राम को दिया। दोनों ने विधिपूर्वक विवाह-संस्कार किए।
panels.speaker: जनक
panels.dialogue: यह सीता तुम्हारी सहधर्मचारिणी हैं।
panels.artAction: Exactly one youthful couple Rama and Sita join hands before small sacred fire, Janaka and officiating Vashishtha, Rama broad calm blue face, Sita red bridal attire.
panels.narrationEn: Before the sacred fire, Janaka placed Sita's hand in Rama's. The two performed the marriage rites according to custom.
panels.dialogueEn: This is Sita, your partner in dharma.

panels.narration: लक्ष्मण ने ऊर्मिला का हाथ ग्रहण किया। दोनों ने अग्नि की परिक्रमा कर बड़ों का आशीर्वाद लिया।
panels.artAction: Exactly one youthful couple tan narrow angular Lakshmana and Urmila in leaf-green bridal silk marry before fire, no Rama recoloured duplicate.
panels.narrationEn: Lakshmana took Urmila's hand. The two circled the sacred fire and received the blessings of their elders.

panels.narration: भरत का विवाह माण्डवी से हुआ। जनक और कुशध्वज के परिवार इन नए सम्बन्धों से जुड़े।
panels.artAction: Exactly one youthful couple Bharata with soft oval face in cream-gold and Mandavi in plum-gold joins hands at sacred fire, Kushadhvaja watching.
panels.narrationEn: Bharata was married to Mandavi. The families of Janaka and Kushadhvaja were joined by these new bonds.

panels.narration: शत्रुघ्न का विवाह श्रुतकीर्ति से हुआ। चारों भाइयों के विवाह पूरे होने पर सभा में आनन्द छा गया।
panels.artAction: Exactly one youthful couple Shatrughna with broader brow teal sash and Shrutakirti in turquoise silk marries before fire, distinct from Bharata.
panels.narrationEn: Shatrughna was married to Shrutakirti. With the weddings of all four brothers complete, joy filled the assembly.

panels.narration: चारों जोड़ों ने अग्नि और बड़ों की परिक्रमा कर आशीर्वाद लिया। मंगलध्वनि के बीच दोनों परिवारों ने उत्सव मनाया।
panels.artAction: Exactly four newlywed couples celebrate together at Mithila courtyard; eight young principals in correct pairs and colours, no missing or extra bride.
panels.narrationEn: All four couples circled the fire and their elders to receive blessings. Amid auspicious music, both families celebrated.

episodes.framingEn: Each of the four couples remains distinct.

episodes.title: परशुराम का प्रश्न
episodes.framing: विवाह के बाद लौटती यात्रा में नया सामना।

panels.narration: अगली सुबह विश्वामित्र ने दोनों राजाओं और राजकुमारों को आशीर्वाद देकर हिमालय की ओर प्रस्थान किया। दशरथ का दल अयोध्या लौटने लगा।
panels.artAction: Elder Vishwamitra blesses exactly four young princes and bids farewell to Dasharatha and Janaka at Mithila gate, no Parashurama yet.
panels.narrationEn: The next morning, Vishvamitra blessed both kings and the princes and set off toward the Himalayas. Dasharatha's party began its journey back to Ayodhya.

panels.narration: मार्ग में अशुभ संकेत और प्रचण्ड आँधी उठी। उसके बीच जमदग्निपुत्र परशुराम धनुष और परशु लेकर सामने आए।
panels.artAction: Two-armed muscular bearded Parashurama appears through dust storm with one axe and one intact Vaishnava bow, returning wedding party halted safely.
panels.narrationEn: Along the way, ill omens appeared and a fierce storm arose. Amid it, Jamadagni's son Parashurama appeared before them, carrying a bow and an axe.

panels.narration: परशुराम ने शिव और विष्णु के दो धनुषों का पुराना इतिहास सुनाया। उनके हाथ का वैष्णव धनुष मिथिला में टूटे शिवधनुष से अलग था।
panels.artAction: Parashurama points to his single intact ornate Vaishnava bow while addressing youthful Rama; no broken Shiva bow mysteriously reappearing.
panels.narrationEn: Parashurama told the old history of the two bows of Shiva and Vishnu. The Vaishnava bow in his hand was different from the bow of Shiva that had broken in Mithila.

panels.narration: दशरथ ने पुत्रों को अभय देने की प्रार्थना की। परशुराम ने राम से सीधे बात कर अपनी चुनौती रखी।
panels.speaker: दशरथ
panels.dialogue: मेरे पुत्रों को अभय दीजिए।
panels.artAction: Dasharatha pleads with stern Parashurama, youthful Rama stands composed, brides safely in caravan background, no Lakshmana taunting duel.
panels.narrationEn: Dasharatha pleaded for his sons' safety. Parashurama spoke directly to Rama and laid down his challenge.
panels.dialogueEn: Grant my sons safety.

panels.narration: परशुराम ने कहा कि राम इस धनुष पर बाण चढ़ाकर अपनी क्षमता दिखाएँ। उसके बाद वे उनसे द्वन्द्व करना चाहते थे।
panels.speaker: परशुराम
panels.dialogue: इस धनुष पर बाण चढ़ाकर दिखाओ।
panels.artAction: Parashurama offers intact Vaishnava bow and arrow to respectful youthful Rama, one axe held safely or set at side, no extra weapons.
panels.narrationEn: Parashurama said that Rama should prove his ability by fitting an arrow to this bow. After that, he wished to duel with him.
panels.dialogueEn: Show me by fitting an arrow to this bow.

episodes.framingEn: A new encounter on the return journey after the weddings.

episodes.title: धनुष का प्रत्युत्तर
episodes.framing: पराक्रम के साथ मर्यादा।

panels.narration: राम पिता के सम्मान से अब तक मौन थे। उन्होंने परशुराम का आदर करते हुए कहा कि उन्हें असमर्थ न समझा जाए।
panels.speaker: राम
panels.dialogue: अब आप मेरा पराक्रम देखिए।
panels.artAction: Close face contrast between youthful serene Rama and mature fierce Parashurama, Rama speaks firmly without mockery, father visible behind.
panels.narrationEn: Out of respect for his father, Rama had remained silent until now. Honoring Parashurama, he said he should not be thought incapable.
panels.dialogueEn: Now witness my strength.

panels.narration: राम ने वैष्णव धनुष लेकर प्रत्यंचा चढ़ाई और बाण लगाया। परशुराम उनके तेज को पहचानकर शान्त होने लगे।
panels.artAction: Youthful Rama strings the intact Vaishnava bow and fits one arrow, Parashurama visibly humbled, no human target struck or bow breaking.
panels.narrationEn: Rama took up the Vaishnava bow, strung it, and fitted an arrow. Recognizing his splendor, Parashurama began to grow calm.

panels.narration: राम ने ब्राह्मण होने और विश्वामित्र से सम्बन्ध के कारण परशुराम को हानि नहीं पहुँचाई। उन्होंने बाण के लिए उनकी तीव्र गति या तप से अर्जित लोकों का विकल्प दिया। परशुराम ने अर्जित लोक त्यागना चुना।
panels.speaker: परशुराम
panels.dialogue: मेरे अर्जित लोकों को लक्ष्य बनाओ।
panels.artAction: Rama holds drawn Vaishnava bow upward away from people, Parashurama consents with lowered axe, symbolic celestial glow as merit is relinquished.
panels.narrationEn: Because Parashurama was a brahmin and connected to Vishvamitra, Rama did him no harm. He gave him a choice for the arrow: his swiftness of movement, or the worlds he had earned through penance. Parashurama chose to give up the worlds he had earned.
panels.dialogueEn: Let the arrow take the worlds I have earned.

panels.narration: राम ने बाण छोड़ा। परशुराम ने उनकी महिमा स्वीकार की, परिक्रमा की और महेन्द्र पर्वत को चले गए।
panels.artAction: Parashurama respectfully bows and departs toward distant mountains after challenge resolves, Rama lowers still-intact bow, daylight returns.
panels.narrationEn: Rama released the arrow. Parashurama acknowledged his greatness, circled him in reverence, and departed for Mount Mahendra.

episodes.framingEn: Valor joined with propriety.

episodes.title: अयोध्या वापसी
episodes.framing: बालकाण्ड का समापन; वनवास अभी आरम्भ नहीं हुआ है।

panels.narration: राम ने वैष्णव धनुष वरुण को सौंपा। दशरथ ने उन्हें हृदय से लगाया और यात्रा फिर अयोध्या की ओर चली।
panels.artAction: Rama respectfully returns single intact bow to dignified two-armed Varuna by water, Dasharatha relieved nearby; no coronation crown on Rama.
panels.narrationEn: Rama handed the Vaishnava bow to Varuna. Dasharatha embraced him warmly, and the journey continued once more toward Ayodhya.

panels.narration: अयोध्या उत्सव से सजी थी। कौसल्या, सुमित्रा और कैकेयी ने सीता, ऊर्मिला, माण्डवी तथा श्रुतकीर्ति का स्वागत किया।
panels.artAction: Three distinct queens welcome exactly four brides at decorated Ayodhya palace doorway, Sita red Urmila green Mandavi plum Shrutakirti turquoise.
panels.narrationEn: Ayodhya was decked for celebration. Kaushalya, Sumitra, and Kaikeyi welcomed Sita, Urmila, Mandavi, and Shrutakirti.

panels.narration: कुछ समय बाद भरत और शत्रुघ्न, पिता और माताओं की अनुमति लेकर, मामा युधाजित के साथ ननिहाल गए।
panels.artAction: Bharata and Shatrughna depart with uncle Yudhajit after greeting Dasharatha and queens, Rama and Lakshmana remain in Ayodhya.
panels.narrationEn: Some time later, Bharata and Shatrughna, with their father's and mothers' permission, went with their uncle Yudhajit to their maternal grandfather's home.

panels.narration: राम-लक्ष्मण पिता के निर्देश पर प्रजा के कार्यों में लगे। राम और सीता का परस्पर स्नेह बढ़ा। यहीं बालकाण्ड की कथा पूर्ण होती है।
panels.artAction: Peaceful ending: youthful Rama and Sita together on Ayodhya garden terrace, gentle mutual affection and city life beyond, no exile clothes or king's crown.
panels.narrationEn: Rama and Lakshmana, under their father's guidance, engaged themselves in the affairs of the people. The mutual love between Rama and Sita grew. Here the story of Balakanda comes to its end.

episodes.framingEn: The conclusion of Balakanda; the exile has not yet begun.
